_readme: See assets/data/README.md. Every value stays null until the team fills it from a real source. Rates are fractions (0.012 = 1.2%). Money is in the market's currency.

min_budget._note: Smallest monthly budget we take on (same as the brief forms). Below it the Forecast points to Vitals Web packages and Vitals Score.

scenario_factors._note: Multiplies the cost per result in each column.

_stretch_note: Team rule for the reality label: a gap up to this fraction reads 'Stretch', above it 'Unrealistic'.
